about.title: About Me
about.description: 👋 Hi, I’m Yousef Amr, also known as Tito — a passionate Full-Stack Developer who loves turning ideas into interactive, functional, and visually appealing web experiences...

paragraphs.one: I am a Front-End Developer specialized in React.js, Next.js and modern web technologies, passionate about creating high-performance, scalable and visually engaging web applications.
paragraphs.two: Combining strong technical skills with a background in Italian Language Studies, I bring analytical thinking, adaptability and effective communication to every team and environment.
paragraphs.three: My focus is building intuitive user experiences, writing clean maintainable code and continuously improving my skills to deliver modern digital solutions with real business value.
